summary: SiliconFlow's API pricing page marks selected models free. Free examples include tencent/Hunyuan-MT-7B and PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR-VL-1.5 (chat input/output), BAAI bge-m3 / bge-reranker-v2-m3 / bge-large-zh-v1.5 / bge-large-en-v1.5 (embedding/reranker models), Kwai-Kolors/Kolors (image), and XingChenAGI XingChenGSR-V1.0 / XingChenASR-V3.2 / XingChenASR-V3.2-Ultra / XingChenASR-Diarize-V3.0 and FunAudioLLM/SenseVoiceSmall (speech). Qwen/Qwen3-ASR-1.7B is paid, currently listed at ¥0.00022 per audio second, and is not a free-model example. Historical checks also removed GLM-Z1-9B-0414 from the free examples.
claim_steps: Choose a model marked 免费/free in the current API pricing catalog. Qwen/Qwen3-ASR-1.7B is paid; do not select it expecting free speech recognition.
Use the selected free model through SiliconFlow's API; recheck the model's current price before making requests.
